runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the flag half word at 0x10

decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reads the flag as a thirty-two bit word; the assembly tests the sixteen bit half word at receiver + 0x10, so the model narrows to the half word
the notify port is called with the literal one, not with the flag value; the corrected model uses the literal
